response: The admin portal allows for the upload and management of contract rate sheets. Once a forwarder uploads their contract rate sheet into their platform via the rate upload module, it notifies the BP team and the uploaded rate files become visible in the admin portal. The portal has two sections: a files module and a rate upload module. The BP team can upload leg-based rates for each mode of shipping for various carriers. These files are then converted into rates by the RMS and stored in the MongoDB leg collection.

The types of users are Forwarder Users and Shipper Users. Forwarder Users belong to the forwarder company and include sales, pricing, operations, and procurement teams. Shipper Users are customers of the forwarder.
